summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the AI Data Analysis Agent (DataSage). 24/24 pytest backend tests pass (health, models, samples listing, 3 sample loads, CSV upload with money/date coercion, XLSX upload, unsupported type guardrail, SQL table+SELECT+DROP guardrail+bad conn, dataset detail/preview/404, overview + cached, ask stream with GPT-6-Luna sql + python approaches, off-topic clarification, follow-up RAG, Claude Sonnet 5.5 model, messages history). Streamlit frontend verified end-to-end: landing hero + 4 capability cards + 3 sample buttons + sidebar (Model select, Upload/Samples/SQL tabs); clicking Sales Orders loads dataset (2,400 rows, 14 cols) with Schema & profile expander, Dataset briefing, insights and 5 suggested questions; clicking a suggested question runs the agent and renders SQL + VALIDATED + rows badges, Answer / Key insights / How this was computed / Caveats markdown, Result table + code expanders, plotly chart; stChatInputTextArea present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py global error handler returns 500 with raw exception text — fine for an MVP but consider sanitizing for production.
datasets._cache is an unbounded in-process dict; large multi-upload sessions could balloon memory. Not a bug for MVP.
agent.ask_stream reuses the same chat object across retries; this is intentional for context carry-over but means a bad plan error message is appended to the LLM history — works fine today.
test_credentials: No auth. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env; demo SQLite at sqlite:////app/backend/data/demo.sqlite
seed_data_creation: None persisted beyond ephemeral mongo datasets created during tests. Datasets saved to /app/backend/data/*.parquet (per-upload).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py — reusable regression. The ask endpoint streams NDJSON; use requests stream=True and json.loads per line. LLM calls take 10-30s each; suite finishes in ~60s with xdist. Frontend is Streamlit — use get_by_role('button', name=...) for sample buttons and query stChatInputTextArea for the input. Allow 15s for dataset load and 30-45s for an ask round trip.
